route: /style-board/ (the style board: module process:list, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames)

findings.issue: The process:list heading "Mock-ups, Strike-offs and Sample Approval" is centred in its intro column, against the rule that every section heading starts on the content's left edge.
findings.reference: The competitor's matching module sets its heading "3 Ways to Handover" flush left with its eyebrow and lead text.
findings.fix: In patterns.css, drop text-align: center from .process__heading, or reset it to start for .point-list .process__heading, so the list variant's heading starts on the left edge.

findings.issue: On phones the heading is centred over a left-aligned numbered list, so the heading and the list below it do not share an edge.
findings.reference: The competitor keeps its heading, lead and steps on one left edge.
findings.fix: The same change to .process__heading (text-align: start in the point-list layout) fixes it at every width.

findings.issue: The step titles ("Scale and trial print", "A4 approval options", …) look the same weight as the body text, so the six steps do not stand out from their descriptions.
findings.reference: The competitor sets each step name ("Custom Designs", "Ready Designs", "Mix n' Match") bold, clearly heavier and a little larger than its body text.
findings.fix: In reference.css, give .block--process .point-list__title font-weight: 700 and font-size: var(--size-subheading) so it matches the process subheading already set at line 220.

findings.issue: The step numbers are the browser's default list numbers ("1.", "2.") in body size and body colour, so the list reads as a plain bulleted text list rather than a process.
findings.reference: The competitor marks each step with a large accent-coloured numeral ("01", "02", "03") in its own column next to the step title.
findings.fix: In reference.css, style .block--process .point-list__item::marker with color: var(--accent-text), a larger font-size and font-weight: 700 (and widen .point-list__items padding-left to fit), or switch to zero-padded counter() numbers in a ::before.

findings.issue: The steps run on with nothing between them, so on the long sample each step blurs into the next.
findings.reference: The competitor separates each step with a thin, light horizontal rule and even padding above and below it.
findings.fix: In reference.css, give .block--process .point-list__item a border-top of 1px solid var(--border-color) with padding-top equal to the list gap (the last item can also take a border-bottom).

findings.issue: The section has no heading: its only intro, "Quality checks at every stage of an order", is a lead line at body size, so the left column looks empty and the section has no title.
findings.reference: The competitor's process list always opens with an H2 ("3 Ways to Handover") above its lead.
findings.fix: Site Factory should supply a heading for overview-steps (e.g. "Quality Checks at Every Stage") so the block renders an h2.process__heading.
